correctness.rationale: For each finite-support ideal element, ad_X has finitely many scalar eigenvalues c(g), so polynomial spectral projectors isolate every c-fiber. Translation by any q with c(q) nonzero then reduces C[X]-coefficients by finite differences; characteristic zero makes the leading coefficient -n c(q) invertible, proving I cap C[X]=(I cap C)[X]. This yields I=A(I cap C), and direct coset decomposition proves contraction after extension. The same finite-difference argument identifies the center, while centrality transfers products, primes, and maximals. The positive-characteristic boundary is verified by the invariant polynomial X^p-X.
